title: There is no meaning-holder apart from the architect
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0086 no longer matches the current design.
decision: There is no meaning-holder apart from the architect, or the persona over it, that holds the context: it approves every example of those contexts. Decision rights are as 0160 and the decision rights concept state.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
